اعتصرتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَرَتَا (iʕtaṣaratā) /iʕ.ta.sˤa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اُعْتُصِرَتَا (uʕtuṣiratā) /uʕ.tu.sˤi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
